Left alembic_version at 033 since the schema now matches head. Verified diagnostic/start returns 200 with 16 questions and a coverage_report.

error_message: Test_4 verbal sec01 mod01 re-run: job failed at 'validating' — annotation missing difficulty_overall on all 33 questions (33 blocking errors), despite 15559 output tokens (not truncated)
root_cause: Output-reorder instruction (added in bug-769 fix) listed difficulty_grammar/difficulty_reading but NOT difficulty_overall. difficulty_overall is never mentioned anywhere in backend/app/prompts/ — the model only emitted it before by inference. With the explicit emit-list constraining the model, it treated the difficulty block as complete and dropped difficulty_overall. Regression introduced by the bug-769 reorder change.
fix: Added difficulty_overall to the emit-order list in both _SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS_TEMPLATE and _SYSTEM_BASE ('...syntactic_trap_key, difficulty_overall, difficulty_grammar, difficulty_reading...'). Restarted backend to clear @lru_cache. Validated: mod01 re-run went from status=failed (33 difficulty_overall blocking) to status=needs_review with 0 difficulty_overall errors and 32/33 questions created/annotated.

error_message: Re-ingesting a previously-complete official PDF rejected with 'This file has already produced a complete ingest (33/33 questions).' even after all its questions were hard-deleted from the DB
root_cause: The dedup guard keys off QuestionAsset.checksum + the prior QuestionJob's stored created_count (_created_count_from_job_payload), NOT off live question rows. Deleting questions (even via the admin DELETE /questions/{id} endpoint) leaves the QuestionAsset and QuestionJob records behind (the admin endpoint detaches question_jobs/question_assets by nulling question_id rather than deleting them). So the guard still sees a prior job with created_count>=expected and rejects. The admin hard-delete endpoint also 500s on questions that have question_source_spans / question_stimulus_assets / question_job_questions rows (ORM tries to null question_id but those columns are NOT NULL -> NotNullViolation).
fix: To cleanly re-ingest a previously-complete official module: (1) delete the questions and ALL question-scoped child rows in dependency order in SQL (stimulus_assets BEFORE source_spans because stimulus_assets.source_span_id FK; options+annotations BEFORE versions; null questions.latest_version_id/latest_annotation_id first to break the circular FK); detach question_jobs/question_assets by nulling question_id (nullable, preserves audit trail). (2) delete the prior QuestionJob row(s) and QuestionAsset row(s) for that module's checksum so the guard's _duplicate_checksum_conflict_detail returns None. Then re-POST /ingest/official/pdf. There is NO force/replace flag on the endpoint.

error_message: GET /admin/tests 500: asyncpg InvalidTextRepresentationError - invalid input value for enum practice_status_enum: "approved"
root_cause: list_tests approved_count case() filtered practice_status IN ('active','approved'), but practice_status_enum only has draft/active/retired/rejected; postgres rejects the cast at query time
fix: changed filter to practice_status == 'active', matching the approved-count convention used elsewhere in admin.py (lines ~1886, ~2180)

error_message: All /api/auth/* endpoints returned 404 — student login, refresh, logout, me were unreachable
root_cause: the student_auth router was fully implemented but never passed to app.include_router(), so the entire auth surface was dead code
fix: imported student_auth in the routers import list and added app.include_router(student_auth.router); verified GET /api/auth/me now returns 401 not 404

error_message: ImportError: The requests library is not installed from please install the requests package to use the requests transport
root_cause: declared google-auth>=2.35 without the [requests] extra; google.auth.transport.requests hard-requires the requests package, which is not otherwise a backend dependency (backend uses httpx)
fix: changed the dependency to google-auth[requests]>=2.35 and installed it into backend/.venv-jb via `uv pip install --python ./.venv-jb/bin/python` (the venv has no pip)

error_message: Segmentation fault (core dumped) — `npx vitest run` in APP/STUDENT_APP_REDUX exits before running a single test
root_cause: Vite dependency (re-)optimization crashes vitest's default worker-thread pool on this Linux host. Any cold cache triggers it — adding a new source directory (src/auth/) invalidates the cache, as does rm -rf node_modules/.vite, which reproduces the segfault on a pre-existing passing test file. vite.config.ts already pins optimizeDeps.bundler:'esbuild' for the same Rolldown/WASM reason, but vitest.config.ts never got the equivalent.
fix: set pool: 'forks' in vitest.config.ts. NOTE: --poolOptions.forks.singleFork=true is NOT a valid alternative — a single shared process leaks module/DOM state across test files (87 failures).

error_message: Student app sent the user_token UUID in the Authorization: Bearer header, where the backend expects a JWT
root_cause: client.ts set `Bearer <user_token>` from VITE_TEST_USER_TOKEN/localStorage. get_current_user decodes a JWT, so that header was never usable; identity actually travelled in request bodies and query params.
fix: Bearer now carries the real JWT access token from the OAuth session (authStore.getAccessToken()); user_token is sourced from GET /api/auth/me and still passed in bodies/params.

error_message: user_token read into module-scope consts in 8 files — evaluated at import time, before a login can exist
root_cause: `const USER_TOKEN = import.meta.env.VITE_TEST_USER_TOKEN || localStorage.getItem('user_token')` at module scope in useDashboardData, useGrammarSession, DiagnosticPage, DiagnosticDetailPage, PracticeTestPage, TestModeTab, DiagnosticTab, DiagnosticDetail, DiagnosticHistory. Module scope evaluates once at import, so a token obtained later at login is never picked up. Swapping only the right-hand side to a getter preserves the bug.
fix: deleted the consts and called getUserToken() at each use site (render/fetch time). getUserToken() prefers the signed-in profile, then falls back to VITE_TEST_USER_TOKEN then localStorage so legacy/scripted use keeps working.

error_message: OAuth Phase 4 hermetic e2e (e2e/oauth-live.mjs) returned 0/9: scenarios crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading newContext)', then '#e2e-gis-button' never appeared (MIME mismatch), then 'No DSAT account' / 'Sign out' selectors timed out, then student dashboard rendered empty #root after sign-in.
root_cause: Multiple harness bugs, not app bugs: (1) scenario fns declared a ctxFactory param but SCENARIOS called them without forwarding the launched browser; (2) page.route('**/api/**') glob also matched dev-served /src/api/client.ts and fulfilled it with JSON, breaking the app module graph; (3) Playwright text="..." (quoted) is an EXACT match, so fragment selectors like 'No DSAT account' never matched the full backend sentence; (4) student UserMenu shows username (email is only a title attr) but harness asserted email; (5) TrapSusceptibilityDashboard reads data.most_susceptible_traps.length with no null guard, so the catch-all [] response threw TypeError and unmounted the whole dashboard tree (no error boundary), hiding UserMenu's Sign out.
fix: (1) wrap each SCENARIOS entry to forward browser as last arg; (2) in installRoutes, route.continue() any request whose pathname has a file extension so source modules reach the dev server; (3) add visibleText/hasText helpers using getByText(exact:false); (4) give STUDENT_PROFILE a username and assert identityMarker=profile.username||profile.email; (5) special-case /api/student/trap-susceptibility to return {total_questions_attempted:0,most_susceptible_traps:[]}. Result: 9/9 green.
